The "'''Manager of Involuntary Labor'''" was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], operating on [[Mek-Sha]] in [[3627 BBY]]. He served as contact to [[the Brothers]] [[Slaver/Legends|slaver]] organization, buying slaves off them. The Imperial official was killed by a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] agent during an attack on the [[Brothers Oversight Center]].<ref name="Brotherhoood Emancipation" />
